easyPrerequisites: In Bolas's Clutches attached to Boonweaver Giant.
description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Boonweaver Giant.
When Boonweaver Giant dies as a legendary creature due to In Bolas's Clutches, Ratadrabik of Urborg triggers, creating a token copy of Boonweaver Giant that is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
When the Boonweaver Giant token enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Boonweaver Giant trigger, returning In Bolas's Clutches from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger from step 3, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
